acceptance.name: product-verification
argv: set -euo pipefail; base="${ABCP_REPOSITORY_BASE_SHA}"; test -n "$base"; git rev-parse --verify "$base^{commit}" >/dev/null; test -n "$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD --)"; git diff --check "$base" HEAD --; marker='P1-CLOSURE-VERIFICATION-OK'; found=0; for f in $(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD --); do   if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qxF "$marker" "$f"; then found=1; fi; done; if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then   echo 'ACCEPTANCE_FAILED: no changed file contains the required marker line' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo 'ACCEPTANCE_OK: candidate changes at least one file and contains the marker'
